name: Frontend Design (Anthropic)
description: New pages: moves Claude off the generic 'AI look' and picks a clear aesthetic direction before coding. The most installed design skill.

name: Impeccable (Paul Bakaus)
description: Audit and polish an existing UI: finds and fixes UX, typography, layout and responsive issues. Many sub-commands (audit, polish, critique…).

name: UI/UX Pro Max
description: Design system from scratch: searchable database of styles, palettes, typography and UX rules. Runs a Python script (needs python3).

name: Taste Skill (design-taste-frontend)
description: A more distinctive, tasteful visual direction and rules to avoid generic templates.

name: Web Design Guidelines (Vercel)
description: UI/UX and accessibility audit against 100+ rules. Doesn't design — reviews existing UI code.

name: Emil Kowalski — design engineering
description: Animation, interaction and 'feel' polish: small, well-reasoned improvements.

name: React & Next.js best practices (Vercel)
description: React/Next.js performance rules: rendering, data fetching, bundle size.

name: Modern Web Guidance (Google Chrome)
description: Up-to-date web platform know-how from Google Chrome, with Firefox and Edge: accessibility, performance, security (CSP, sanitization, passkeys), forms, dialogs, layout and modern HTML/CSS instead of custom JavaScript. Claude looks up the right guide before writing UI code.

name: Playwright MCP (Microsoft)
description: Lets Claude open the UI in a real browser: screenshots, clicks, console errors. Most useful together with the design skills.

name: Context7 (Upstash)
description: Up-to-date, version-specific library docs — reduces outdated or invented API usage.
